Symfony CLI version 5.20.0 (c) 2021-2026 Fabien Potencier

Usage:
  command [options] [arguments]

Options:
  -h, --help     Display help for the given command.
  -V, --version  Display this application version.

Available commands:
  book
   book:check-requirements, book:check  Check that you have all the pre-requisites locally
   book:checkout                        Check out a step of the book repository
  cloud
   cloud:clear-cache, cloud:cc          Clear the CLI cache
   cloud:console, cloud:web             Open the project in the Console
   cloud:deploy                         Deploy an environment
  local
   local:new                            Create a new Symfony project
   local:server:start                   Run a local web server
   local:server:stop                    Stop the local web server
  self
   self:completion                      Dump the shell completion script
   self:help, help, list                Display help for a command or a category of commands
   self:version, version                Display the application version
